NBA DFS Picks for Saturday, October 24 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Saturday, October 24 · 5 games · First game 7:30 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 24, 2:54 PM ET

Victor Wembanyama (SAS) is the top-projected player on the Saturday, October 24 DraftKings main slate at 57.0 DraftKings points for $10,700. Anthony Davis (WAS, 47.5, $8,700) and Jaylen Brown (PHI, 46.7, $7,700) are next.

Naji Marshall (DAL) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.85 projected points per $1,000 at $4,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 24, 2:54 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
